## Description {#details}

<p>A reimplementation of <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/moduloscheduleexpander">ModuloScheduleExpander</a>.</p>


<p>It works by generating a standalone kernel loop and peeling out the prologs and epilogs.</p>
